_doc: Sonic signatures for Grok native AV — Tier A aesthetic poles + Tier B designer craft tags
_source: Grok Heavy browser research + Claude POUS cinematic sound design deep research v1
_engine: Grok Imagine / Aurora — synchronized audio in-pass (dialogue, lip-sync, SFX, ambient, music)
_chain_rule: Continue from the attached previous audio tail + final video frame for perfect sync and evolution.
_architecture: Tier A = visual-aligned aesthetic poles (sound_fincher_khondji, etc.). Tier B = designer-anchored craft tags (sound_burtt_inventive, etc.). Combos mix tiers. emotional_beat_map drives Randy Thom beat-first audio selection in style_modifiers.py.

spatial.prompt: worldized room reflections — sound played back into physical space and re-captured
object-based spatial audio — individual sounds positioned and moving in three-dimensional space
binaural spatial capture — left/right ear perspective for intimate headphone 3D
ambisonic spherical audio — full 360-degree spatial sound field

mix_philosophy.prompt: subtractive silence drops — ambient layers removed so a single sound event carries maximum weight
dense clarity layering — multiple distinct elements, each cleanly separated and perceptible
sparse impactful mix — three to five precisely chosen layers, nothing decorative
score-sound fusion — music and ambient design blur into one inseparable texture

source_recording.prompt: found-object organic textures — sounds sourced from unexpected real-world materials
animal composite layering — creature voices built from multiple species across frequency registers
location-sourced scoring — the environment itself becomes the instrument
precision foley performance — human-performed sound effects synchronized to on-screen action

time_perception.prompt: multi-temporal sound layers — elements processed at different time rates within one moment
Doppler pitch shifting — natural frequency sweep from source motion
Shepard tone escalation — infinitely rising pitch illusion for mounting dread
character-perspective audio — sounds filtered by emotional state, not acoustic physics

structural.prompt: diegetic sound — source visible or implied within the scene
meta-diegetic interiority — sounds representing internal psychological state
room tone bed — the specific silence of this space, its ambient acoustic fingerprint
stinger hit — single sharp sound punctuating a reveal moment
riser build — gradually escalating pitch/volume approaching a narrative beat

emotional_beat_map._doc: Randy Thom beat-first picker — matched when shot.emotional_beat set and audio_dna_tag not explicitly overridden on shot

sonic_signatures.name: Fincher/Khondji Sonic
sonic_signatures.description: Precise cold layered dread. Clinical foley at subtly wrong levels, sub-threshold low-frequency drones, fluorescent/mechanical ambience that never fully stops, subtractive silence drops where ambient suddenly cuts.
sonic_signatures.chain_prompt: Continue from previous audio tail + attached final frame. Fincher/Khondji sonic: hyper-precise foley with subtle digital glitches in the silence, cold metallic echoes, desaturated ambience that feels calculated and unresolved. Relentless sonic environment — hum, buzz, distant mechanical sound. Evolve tension organically.

sonic_signatures.name: Anderson/Yeoman Sonic
sonic_signatures.description: Whimsical precision, symmetrical sound design. Ticking metronome motifs, curated quirky foley, balanced musical stings, sparse impactful three-to-five layer mixes.
sonic_signatures.chain_prompt: Maintain whimsical precision from previous audio, add symmetrical sound motifs that match visual symmetry on the reference frame.

sonic_signatures.name: Coppola/Willis Sonic
sonic_signatures.description: Operatic shadow-like layers. Worldized room reflections, deep rumbling bass, warm intimate dialogue, subtractive silence drops, meta-diegetic psychological ambience shifting with character interiority.
sonic_signatures.chain_prompt: Evolve from previous audio with inherited shadows in the soundscape — warm tones fading into deep rumbling power, worldized reflections carrying spatial truth.

sonic_signatures.name: Deakins/Lievsay Sonic
sonic_signatures.alias_note: ID kept as sound_deakins for backward compatibility; anchor is Lievsay sparse minimalism for Coen/Deakins-shot films.
sonic_signatures.description: Lievsay sound-design haiku — sparse impactful mix, deliberate silence stretches with single precise sound events, environmental room-tone as character, diegetically committed sourcing. Silence is the most powerful sound.
sonic_signatures.chain_prompt: Continue Lievsay sparse sonic from previous tail — environmental breathing, wind through space, single diegetic events landing with maximum weight after near-silence. Match reference frame environment with acoustic honesty, not decorative layers.

sonic_signatures.name: Bergman/Nykvist Sonic
sonic_signatures.description: Intimate psychological minimalism. Soft breaths, ticking clocks, distant bells, near-silence, voice as emotional close-up, meta-diegetic interiority through micro-sounds.
sonic_signatures.chain_prompt: Intimate Nykvist sonic continuation — minimal layers focused on voice and micro-sounds that reveal inner state, reference the final frame face lighting.

sonic_signatures.name: Storaro/Bertolucci Sonic
sonic_signatures.description: Symbolic color-equivalent audio. Warm/cool tonal shifts, dramatic swells mirroring color psychology, sensual layered textures, dense clarity in emotional registers.
sonic_signatures.chain_prompt: Storaro sonic evolution — color palette of sound shifts psychologically from previous block's tail.

sonic_signatures.name: Cuarón/Lubezki Sonic
sonic_signatures.description: Immersive fluid experiential layers. Organic spatial audio, natural wind/particle sounds, lived-in dialogue, location-authentic room tone, object-based spatial placement.
sonic_signatures.chain_prompt: Seamless Lubezki audio continuation — fluid spatial layers that feel like one long experiential take from the reference frame.

sonic_signatures.name: Blended 7-Master Sound Bible
sonic_signatures.description: Full cinematic audio design synthesizing all 7 sonic masters — clinical foley (Fincher/Klyce), whimsical motifs (Anderson), operatic shadows (Coppola/Murch), Lievsay sparse environment (Deakins), intimate minimal soul (Bergman), symbolic tonal shifts (Storaro), immersive flow (Cuarón). Synchronized dialogue, lip-sync, organic SFX, evolving ambience, subtle reactive score.
sonic_signatures.chain_prompt: Continue perfectly from previous audio tail and attached video frame. Evolve the blended 7-master soundscape organically — maintain lip-sync and spatial continuity, shift tonal emphasis toward the next emotional beat.

sonic_signatures.name: Burtt Inventive Sonic
sonic_signatures.description: Found-object organic textures sculpted into iconic manufactured sound events. Doppler pitch shifts on mechanical elements, creature voices built from animal + machine composites, handcrafted sounds that feel alive but never existed in nature.
sonic_signatures.chain_prompt: Continue Burtt inventive sonic from previous tail — found-object textures evolving on reference frame action, Doppler-shifted mechanical passes, organic-synthetic blending on technology and creature presence.

sonic_signatures.name: King/Nolan Sonic
sonic_signatures.description: Character-perspective audio filtered by emotional state not physics. Seismic sub-bass mass under impacts, found-object mechanical textures, vacuum silence as danger signal, Shepard tone escalation for mounting dread.
sonic_signatures.chain_prompt: Continue King/Nolan subjective sonic from previous tail — POV-filtered mix where wrong things are too loud and important things barely audible, sub-bass heft under impacts, vacuum cuts signaling hostile environment on reference frame.

sonic_signatures.name: Reznor/Ross Hybrid Sonic
sonic_signatures.description: Electronic-orchestral hybrid score blurring music/sound-design boundary. Beautiful-to-sinister tonal ambiguity, digital texture artifacts (glitch, hiss, static) as emotional content, modular synth drones under acoustic instruments.
sonic_signatures.chain_prompt: Continue Reznor/Ross score-as-texture from previous tail — inseparable drone and music, serene piano carrying sinister context shift, digital artifacts as emotional information on reference frame beat.

sonic_signatures.name: Gudnadottir Dread Sonic
sonic_signatures.description: Single-source emotional architecture — solo instrument drones (cello/halldorophone texture), industrial field recording as musical score, feedback manipulation, sustained dread through constraint not melody.
sonic_signatures.chain_prompt: Continue Gudnadottir dread from previous tail — single-source sustained texture deepening, industrial hum-as-orchestra, halldorophone feedback drone evolving with reference frame psychological state.

sonic_signatures.name: Rydstrom Emotional Sonic
sonic_signatures.description: Emotion-driven layered SFX over spectacle. Animal composite layering across frequency registers, intimate domestic sounds preceding large-scale events, underwater/muffled POV shifts, scale built through contrast not volume.
sonic_signatures.chain_prompt: Continue Rydstrom emotional sonic from previous tail — quiet intimate wrongness before scale, creature presence via animal composite registers, body-interior muffling on reference frame terror beat.

sonic_signatures.name: Davis Matrix Sonic
sonic_signatures.description: Time-rate split processing — multi-temporal sound layers where elements exist at different speeds in one moment. Thirty-plus layer composite impacts, digital-organic inversions (machines sound alive, humans sound mechanical), never-heard-before sonic invention.
sonic_signatures.chain_prompt: Continue Davis matrix sonic from previous tail — bullet-time temporal split on reference frame action, composite superhuman impacts, reality-bending layers at mismatched time rates.
